# CardActionsStack

`Flare.Components.CardActionsStack`

Card width below which FlareCardActions stacks its actions. These are CONTAINER widths, not viewport breakpoints: what decides whether two buttons fit side by side is how wide the card is, so a card in a narrow column stacks on a wide screen too.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Never` | `0` | Never stack automatically (the default). |
| `Narrow` | `1` | Stack below 20rem (320px) - only genuinely cramped cards. |
| `Compact` | `2` | Stack below 30rem (480px) - the phone-width card. |
| `Wide` | `3` | Stack below 40rem (640px) - anything short of a full-width card. |

## Used by components

- `FlareCardActions`
